nodes.label: ADR 0019 — Stages et habilitations par nœud et action
nodes.norm_label: adr 0019 — stages et habilitations par nœud et action

nodes.label: Capability-aware administration
nodes.rationale: Remote providers may not support account resets or management, so UI and server checks must honor capabilities.

nodes.label: Extensible authentication and authorization
nodes.rationale: AD, third-party API or optional local accounts must not change Core.

nodes.label: Audited local administrator bootstrap
nodes.rationale: One-time local operations and last-admin protection avoid permanent public recovery endpoints.

nodes.label: Internal permission profiles
nodes.rationale: Direct identity assignments and optional directory group mapping separate authentication from authorization.

nodes.label: Revocable server-side sessions
nodes.rationale: Configurable idle/max durations and remote status rechecks bound revocation latency rather than promising instant remote revocation.

nodes.label: ProviderId SubjectId stable identity
nodes.rationale: Select authentication and authorization providers explicitly; no automatic credential fallback or implicit permission aggregation.

nodes.label: Explicit eligible approver designation
nodes.rationale: Availability varies, so no approver is automatically inferred from the directory manager attribute.

nodes.label: Versioned durable approver assignment
nodes.rationale: Selection survives restart but grants are checked again at activation and submission; no silent reassignment.

nodes.label: Context-bound candidate search
nodes.rationale: Search only authorized candidates; persist selected stable identity instead of typed text or email.

nodes.label: Generic read-only LDAP extension
nodes.rationale: LDAP is a protocol rather than a universal enterprise schema; AD becomes separately configured and qualified compatibility.

nodes.label: LDAPS with validated chain and hostname
nodes.norm_label: ldaps with validated chain and hostname
nodes.rationale: No automatic downgrade after TLS failure; cleartext requires explicit configuration and StartTLS is deferred.

nodes.label: Real Linux OpenLDAP qualification
nodes.rationale: Windows/macOS unit contracts do not claim an LDAP instance; macOS cleartext tests do not prove LDAPS.

nodes.label: Capability-declared optional directory groups
nodes.rationale: Schema-specific strategies and bounded queries avoid assuming universal memberOf or nested-group behavior.

nodes.label: Configured immutable LDAP subject codec
nodes.rationale: DN, login, display name and email cannot substitute silently for a stable identity.

nodes.label: DesignatedIdentity and EligiblePool
nodes.rationale: Eligibility determines candidates; durable assignment or exclusive claim determines who treats a task.

nodes.label: Positive exact workflow node action grants
nodes.norm_label: positive exact workflow node action grants
nodes.rationale: Default deny and current policy revision prevent implicit wildcard access and stale authorization.

nodes.label: Instance reading separate from stage action eligibility
nodes.norm_label: instance reading separate from stage action eligibility
nodes.rationale: Being eligible for one action never grants unrestricted data visibility across stages.

nodes.label: Stage equals workflow node
nodes.rationale: Reuse stable NodeId without a separate Stage entity; definition declares actions while installation owns grants.

nodes.label: Rejet mauvais nom
nodes.rationale: 127.0.0.2 is absent from certificate and tests invalid-name rejection.

nodes.label: Reusable modules across installations
nodes.rationale: Copying a module must not copy identities or workflow instances.

nodes.label: One logical installation per organisation
nodes.rationale: Separate administration, data, configuration and secrets without MVP engine multi-tenancy.

nodes.label: ADR 0011 — Auto-approbation configurable, interdite par défaut
nodes.norm_label: adr 0011 — auto-approbation configurable, interdite par defaut

nodes.label: Self approval forbidden by default
nodes.rationale: Workflow exceptions must be explicit and never bypass permissions or assignment.

nodes.label: Stable-identity server approval validation
nodes.rationale: The server compares stable subjects at submission independently of UI and provider; versioned policy prevents silent changes to existing instances.
